flashcards.back: The lower nature is material energy; the higher nature is Spirit (Purusha), which sustains the whole universe.

flashcards.front: Lower nature: what is in it?
flashcards.back: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect and ego.
All creatures evolve from God's twofold energy, and God is the origin and dissolution of the whole universe.
Nothing is higher than God; everything is strung on him like jewels on the thread of a necklace.
God's divine power of the three modes, very hard to overcome. Only those who surrender to him cross it easily.
The distressed, the seeker of Self-knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the enlightened one.

flashcards.front: Which of the four is highest?
flashcards.back: The enlightened devotee with single-minded love, who sees that everything is God (7.19). Such a soul is very rare.
God steadies the faith of whoever worships any deity with faith, and their wishes are granted, but only by him.
Among thousands who strive, scarcely one knows him truly; most are deluded by likes and dislikes.
Not understanding God's transcendental form, they think he is formless and takes form as humans do.
Complete Self-knowledge with enlightenment, after which nothing more remains to be known.

quiz.text: What is God's higher nature, per 7.5?
quiz.why: Material energy is the lower nature; Spirit (Purusha) is the higher.
7.7: there is nothing higher than God.

quiz.text: Which is NOT one of the four who seek God (7.16)?
quiz.why: The four are the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, the enlightened.

quiz.text: Who grants the wishes of a deity's worshippers?
quiz.why: 7.21-22: faith in any form is steadied by God; wishes come from him.

quiz.text: Why is the enlightened soul who knows God "very rare"?
quiz.why: Among thousands, scarcely one truly knows him.

quiz.text: What remains to be known after this knowledge?
quiz.why: Krishna's promise: complete knowledge and enlightenment.

quiz.text: What do the ignorant wrongly think of God (7.24)?

options.A: That he is formless and takes form as humans do

quiz.why: They miss his unborn, transcendental form.

children.text: Not formless, as the ignorant think
